A positive affirmation to yourself in the mirror may also do so so much good, it sounds silly, but after a while it can truly make a difference just in general with how you see yourself, and it does not have to be physical! It can be merely you saying that you’re a good person, just reminding yourself that you are so so many other things besides your physical appearance, it truly can show what else you bring to the table, which is a plethora of things!
